title: Four Happy Children & Small Dog on Sofa, 1960 B&W Indoor Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white family snapshot captured in September 1960, featuring four young children and a small black dog gathered comfortably on a mid-century sofa inside a suburban home. The children display cheerful, relaxed expressions while dressed in classic post-war casual attire, including short-sleeved button-down shirts, cuffed jeans, sneakers, and a puffed-sleeve dress. A set dining table appears in the foreground, framing this intimate portrait of middle-class American domestic life.
